items.label: Paystack secret key
items.description: From the Paystack dashboard (starts with sk_). Stored encrypted; it is never shown again.

items.label: Paystack API address
items.description: Leave as it is unless you test against another server.

items.label: OpenStreetMap Nominatim address
items.description: The public server allows about one request a second; run your own Nominatim for real use.

items.label: OpenStreetMap contact
items.description: An email address or website that identifies you to the map server, as its usage policy asks.
